theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_plane_imrep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (c : ℤ), Orthonormal ℝ τ → c ≠ 0 → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), ω x τ ∂μHE[n]) ∧ R.measure = (c.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
